hooks.command: REPO="/Users/henrywalton/claude/annas-projects/screenScribe"; DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); FILE="$REPO/docs/changelogs/$DATE.md"; mkdir -p "$REPO/docs/changelogs"; [ -f "$FILE" ] || printf '# Changes — %s\n\n' "$(date '+%B %-d, %Y')" > "$FILE"; git -C "$REPO" add -A; git -C "$REPO" diff --cached --quiet || git -C "$REPO" commit -m "Auto-commit $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" >/dev/null
